criteria.question: Does the edition preserve legible PDF evidence and identify every departure?
Is there a complete playable choice, with no placeholder asking the reviewer to compose the missing material?
Does each completion make the smallest musically defensible change supported by this PDF?
Is the complete route finite, consistent with readable directions, and musically connected through destination-appropriate endings?
Are uncertain locations, the adopted choice, reasons and meaningful alternatives recorded?

editorial_rubric.alternative_policy: Evaluate a whole coherent reconstruction or route. Agreement with one approved edition is descriptive, not the only acceptable answer. No new alternative receives approval automatically.
editorial_rubric.source_policy: PDF only. Historical recording-informed edition decisions are excluded from source-note truth.
